title: Developmental Stages
learningGoal: Help parents understand age‑appropriate behaviour and developmental milestones.
microLesson: Children grow through predictable stages—physical, emotional, social, and cognitive. Understanding these stages helps parents set realistic expectations and respond with patience. When behaviour is viewed through a developmental lens, parents can support growth instead of reacting with frustration.
activity: Choose one behaviour your child shows. Identify which developmental stage it relates to and reflect on how this changes your response.
